description: Resident population by county, series, date, sex and 5-year age group (0-4 ... 85+)
original_variables: TOT_MALE, TOT_FEMALE by AGEGRP 1-18 and YEAR 1-7
transformation: AGEGRP-1 -> age 0-17; YEAR -> date via config/sources.yaml year_codes; sex from column
missing_values: Counties lacking any cell are skipped for a run (listed in skipped.csv)

original_variables: TOT_MALE, TOT_FEMALE by AGEGRP and YEAR
transformation: As above; April 2010 / April 2020 codes checked against census counts

original_variables: ESTIMATESBASE2000, POPESTIMATE2000-2010, CENSUS2010POP by SEX 1-2, AGEGRP 1-18
transformation: Column -> date (Apr 1 2000 base; Jul 1 of each year; Apr 1 2010 census)

description: Census 2010 and 2020 counts by sex and age (census2010, census2020)
Births to county residents, July 1 of year_end-1 to June 30 of year_end
transformation: First (partial April-June) year of each vintage dropped
missing_values: Incomplete windows -> county takes its state fertility index

variable: qx, lx, dx, Lx, Tx, ex
description: Single-year period life tables, ages 0-99 and 100+, by sex
dataset: U.S. Life Tables 2010 (NVSR 63-7), 2024 (NVSR 75-5); U.S. State Life Tables 2019 (NVSR 70-18), 2022 (NVSR 74-12)
original_variables: Age label, qx, lx, dx, Lx, Tx, ex
transformation: Five-year survival ratios computed in the engines (S[a] = 5L(a+5)/5L(a); 85+ uses T90/T85; births 5L0/(5 l0))
missing_values: Missing state table -> U.S. table of the same id

table_or_endpoint: NVSR 61(1) Tables 3 and A; NVSR 70(2) Table 2; NVSR 75(2) Table 2
original_variables: Published rates (2009 age 45-49 derived from the published TFR)

description: Population and owner/renter householders by householder age (15-24 ... 85+)
transformation: Population cells summed to householder age groups (both sexes)

table_or_endpoint: B01001 and B25007 margins of error (…M)
transformation: SE = MOE / 1.645; aggregated cells SE = sqrt(sum SE^2); MOE code -555555555 (controlled) -> 0

variable: hu_total, occupied, for_rent, rented_not_occ, for_sale, sold_not_occ, seasonal, migrant, other_vacant
description: Housing units by occupancy and vacancy status
missing_values: Missing -> gap not computed for that county

dataset: 2000 SF1; 2010 SF1; 2020 DHC; PEP Vintage 2025 housing-unit estimates
transformation: Excel table rows ('.County, State') matched to FIPS via the PEP county names
missing_values: Unmatched names reported by a check

description: Housing units authorized by building permits, calendar year
original_variables: Units columns (estimates with imputation) for 1, 2, 3-4, 5+ unit structures
missing_values: County absent from a year's file -> 0 permits

description: Households by tenure and HUD income band (<=30, 30-50, 50-80, 80-100, >100% HAMFI)
original_variables: Owner T8_est3, 16, 29, 42, 55; renter T8_est69, 82, 95, 108, 121 (verify against the release's data dictionary)
transformation: Shares within tenure computed in the engines
missing_values: Bands must sum to tenure totals (check)

description: Annual average total covered employment and average weekly wage
transformation: Annualized log growth computed in the employment add-on
missing_values: Missing growth -> no employment adjustment for that county
